We need to build complete retrosynthesis route JSON. We have target molecule? From template search: mapped_rxn shows product SMILES? The mapped_rxn is reaction: reactants -> product. The product SMILES appears after >>. Let's extract product: after >> is "[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1(/[CH:6]=[CH:7]/[c:8]2[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]2)[CH:14]=[C:15]1[Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19]". That's the target molecule SMILES (without atom maps). Remove map numbers: CH3 O C(=O) C1(/CH=CH/c2ccccc2)[CH]=C1[Si](C)(C)C? Let's convert: "[CH3][O][C](=O)[C]1(/CH=CH/[c]2[cH][cH][cH][cH][cH]2)[CH]=[C]1[Si](C)(C)C". So target SMILES: "COC(=O)C1(/C=C/c2ccccc2)C= C1[Si](C)(C)C"? Wait need correct. Let's just use the SMILES from precursors list? The apply_template answer gave precursors: ['C#C[Si](C)(C)C', 'COC(=O)C(=O)CCc1ccccc1'].

Thus target is product of those via template 1914386. So route: root molecule with smiles target, child reaction with template_id 1914386, children are two precursor molecules with given SMILES.

We should verify step using verify_step maybe. Let's call verify_step with target smiles (need exact). Use product SMILES without maps: we can reconstruct from mapped_rxn: remove map tags. Let's quickly produce: "[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1(/[CH:6]=[CH:7]/[c:8]2[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]2)[CH:14]=[C:15]1[Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19]". Removing map numbers and brackets: "COC(=O)C1(/C=C/c2ccccc2)C= C1[Si](C)(C)C". Need correct SMILES: "COC(=O)C1(/C=C/c2ccccc2)C= C1[Si](C)(C)C". There is extra space. Should be "COC(=O)C1(/C=C/c2ccccc2)C=C1[Si](C)(C)C". That seems plausible.

Let's verify.
